name: Lotte Hotel Hanoi
detail: It seems to have taken about 15-20 minutes to get to the Old Town, but it felt closer from the airport, and since Lotte Department Store and a grocery store were together, shopping and sightseeing were convenient. The swimming pool was well maintained and spacious, making it very convenient to use, and the gym appeared to be well managed with staff on duty. The attitude of the staff was, of course, excellent, and what stood out the most was the view, which was very satisfying both from inside the room and while having breakfast. The check-in and check-out process was smooth, and the price was slightly higher than typical Old Town hotels, but the overall satisfaction was more than double.

name: Palette Ngoc Ha Luxury Residence
detail: A worthwhile choice with a clean space, full amenities, and well-cared rooms. The bathroom is tidy, Wi-Fi works well, and transportation is quite convenient. The staff is friendly and very helpful, providing a comfortable stay experience. The location is fairly decent, although not the most convenient.

name: Townhouse Starlake Residence
detail: The room is clean, airy, new, and odor-free, but the location is a bit inconvenient for my commute to work. The staff here are enthusiastic in assisting customers, welcoming guests, and providing quick support.
area: Tu Liem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Hanoi Railway Capsule
detail: This is a place where you can stay安心 regardless of the length of your stay. The staff is trustworthy, and you can easily consult them about anything. Upon check-in, you will be shown to your own shoe locker and locker. At that time, you can also borrow sandals. The area with rooms in the building is air-conditioned, and there are fans both in the rooms and in the dining area. The beds in the rooms are large, and there are sliding doors and curtains, so you don’t have to worry about privacy. For safety, there are surveillance cameras installed inside the building, and the gates are locked at night, providing peace of mind. Breakfast is provided every day in a paper bag and is placed in front of your room. You can eat at any time you like, allowing you to move at your own pace. Convenience stores, food stalls, dining spots, and tourist attractions are all within walking distance. If you know the way, you can reach it from Hanoi Station in about 10 to 15 minutes. The cost performance is good, and it's cheap yet clean and safe. You can use this accommodation as a base to join day tours or excursions to the suburbs. You need to bring your own bath towels, while shampoo and body soap are provided in the shower room. There’s also a laundry nearby, so large laundry items are not a problem. The staff is really kind and helped me during my stay.

name: Hanoi Daewoo Hotel
detail: It's a 40-50 minute distance from the airport, and there's a Lotte Mart across the street which is convenient. The rooms are spacious, clean, and quiet. Although it's elliptical, the long swimming pool and fitness facilities are also good. The breakfast is excellent, but it's almost the same every day and I think there were a lot of Japanese channels on the TV. In short, it's great value for money!

name: Bespoke Trendy Hotel Hanoi Hotel
detail: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommend the Bespoke Trendy Hotel in Hanoi! ❤️ I want to recommend the Bespoke Trendy Hotel where I stayed during my trip to Hanoi! It was a really satisfying accommodation. 😊 1. Staff Friendliness 💕 The staff are really, really friendly! From the moment I checked in, they took great care of me, making my stay enjoyable. We arrived a bit early, but they helped us check in right away and even upgraded our room, which was truly touching. Thanks to them, I was able to relax in a spacious and comfortable room! 2. Room Condition and Cleanliness 🛏️ The hotel and room were generally clean and tidy. The upgraded room was spacious and pleasant, allowing me to have a comfortable stay during my trip. I recommend it to those who prioritize cleanliness! 3. Water Quality 🚿 I brought a shower filter for my trip to Hanoi, but the shower was fixed to the wall, so I couldn't use it. Still, the water quality felt really good, to the point where I didn’t need to bring a filter! Of course, this is a personal experience, but I was satisfied with the water quality. 4. Breakfast 🍽️ What can I say about breakfast… it was really delicious! 😍 I was able to enjoy meals each morning, and being satisfied with the breakfast increased my overall satisfaction with the stay. I recommend booking with breakfast included! 5. Location 📍 The location was also very convenient! It was easy to walk to nearby tourist attractions and restaurants, making it a very satisfactory spot for exploring Hanoi. I recommend it to those who want to reduce travel time and enjoy their trip leisurely. 6. Airport Pickup and Shuttle Service 🚗 I also used the airport pickup and shuttle service, which made traveling to and from the airport very convenient. I didn’t have to look for transportation in an unfamiliar country, making the start and end of my trip much smoother. Overall Assessment ❤️ I was satisfied with every aspect of the hotel, from the friendliness of the staff to the cleanliness of the rooms, delicious breakfast, and convenient location. Especially, the early check-in and room upgrade left me with even better memories. If you are considering accommodation in Hanoi, I highly recommend the Bespoke Trendy Hotel! It’s a place I would love to stay at again when I visit Hanoi next time. 🥰

name: Madelise Palace Hotel & Spa
detail: The hotel has just been renovated and upgraded, so the facilities are still new, the rooms are spacious, clean, and comfortable. The space is airy, and the room size is good compared to many other hotels. It is definitely worth choosing for your stay. I recommend everyone to experience it!

name: Hanoi TrangTrang Premium Hotel & Sky Bar
detail: Everybody should stay at this hotel to try the service!!! The location is super convenient. Every store and restaurant is just 2 minutes from here. The room is cozy, the AC is good, quite clean and enough for just 1 night here. The staff - Grace, Lily, Tuna are so friendly, helpful and happy anytime I asked for support. The view from the rooftop is incredible. The panorama view of Hoan Kiem Lake on the 11th floor is amazing. I love it ☺️ Highly recommend this place for all my friends!!!

name: The One Hostel Hanoi
detail: The hostel is very close to the center—I stayed for three days and walked to most of the famous attractions in about 15 minutes. The room was cleaned daily. Aside from one time when the shower water got too hot, everything else was fantastic. The pool was clean, the rooftop bar and music were great. Definitely a place worth experiencing for solo travelers!❤️
area: Dong Xuan Market,Hanoi - View on map

name: Carillon Boutique Hotel
detail: It's good that the location is close to various places. The room condition is also decent, and the service is friendly. If you ever come back or are looking for a good accommodation within a reasonable range, I recommend this place.
